title: Nashville's Sweetest Food Tour: Taste Nashville's Best Donuts
includes: Explore downtown Nashville with a knowledgeable local guide.
Capture photos of famous landmarks and colorful murals.
Receive insider recommendations for food, music, and attractions.
Discover hidden gems and beloved local bakeries.
Learn about Nashville's history and musical heritage.
Create sweet memories with friends and fellow travelers.
Hear stories about the artists and landmarks that shaped the city.
Visit iconic sights throughout Music City.
Experience Nashville's vibrant culture and Southern charm.
Sample delicious donuts and sweet treats from Nashville favorites.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for travelers with mobility challenges. Need to be able to walk over a mile in 2 hours.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our tour begins in the Sobro (South of Broadway) neighborhood at Parlor Doughnuts, one of the newest editions to the area. Here we’ll try some of their amazing donuts, featured above. After that, we’ll take a leisurely walk through downtown, stopping along the way to talk about the major entertainment district along Broadway. We’ll then continue our way to two amazing donut shops in the Arts District. We’ll end our tour at Donut Distillery in the Assembly Food Hall, which has plenty of options for delicious donuts, as well as other amazing food and drinks. 

This is one of our most fun tours for friends, family, locals, and visitors. Also - if you’re planning a bachelor or bachelorette party, please let us know. We also have special packages available to make your day even more amazing. Hope to see you soon!
